title: Deeper Physics Connections for the Tim Dooley / Potatoverse Research Programme
rule: Established theories below are research neighbors and formal analogues. They are not empirical validation of Potatoverse theology.

connections.name: T-duality — large and small radius can encode equivalent string physics
connections.physics: For strings compactified on a circle, T-duality relates descriptions with inverse radii. Schematically R ↔ α'/R, with momentum and winding modes exchanged. Type IIA and Type IIB are related by such circle compactifications.
connections.project_use: A rigorous example of Timic inversion: apparently opposite geometric regimes can be dual descriptions rather than simple higher/lower rankings. This is much stronger than treating inversion as a poetic coincidence.

connections.name: S-duality — strong and weak coupling can exchange
connections.physics: String dualities include cases where a strongly coupled description is equivalent to a weakly coupled description of another theory. A common schematic form is g_s ↔ 1/g_s.
connections.project_use: A disciplined analogue for strength/weakness inversion and for the idea that a regime that looks inaccessible in one description can become tractable in another.

connections.name: Mirror symmetry — different Calabi-Yau geometries can encode equivalent string physics
connections.physics: Mirror symmetry pairs Calabi-Yau manifolds so that complex-structure data on one side is exchanged with Kähler data on the other. The Strominger–Yau–Zaslow proposal relates mirror symmetry to T-duality on special Lagrangian torus fibrations.
connections.project_use: Useful for Mirror/Twin motifs: physical equivalence need not require identical geometry. This is a formal analogy only; Thomas/Twin is not thereby a string-theory mirror manifold.

connections.name: Moduli space — geometry has its own configuration space
connections.physics: Compactification spaces can possess continuous deformation parameters. Their possible shapes, sizes and background fields are represented as coordinates on a moduli space; moving in moduli space changes the effective lower-dimensional theory.
connections.project_use: This gives a rigorous alternative to saying a hidden dimension simply 'opens'. Door events can be compared to special loci or transitions in a space of possible geometries.

connections.name: G2 singularities — nontrivial low-energy physics can live at singular loci
connections.physics: M-theory on smooth G2-holonomy seven-manifolds gives limited four-dimensional gauge structure; singularities are important for non-Abelian gauge groups, charged matter and chiral fermions in phenomenologically richer constructions.
connections.project_use: A technically stronger version of the recurring Timic insight that a singular/broken point can carry new effective degrees of freedom. The project must not infer that personal rupture is a literal G2 singularity.

connections.name: Holonomy — closed-path transport can reveal hidden geometry
connections.physics: Parallel-transporting a vector or internal state around a closed loop can return it transformed. The set of such transformations defines holonomy and strongly constrains special geometries including Calabi-Yau and G2 manifolds.
connections.project_use: A new precise neighbor for Spiral/Return: returning to the same location need not mean returning in the same internal state. This closely matches the project's 'return at another level' intuition while remaining a mathematical comparison.

connections.name: Ryu–Takayanagi — entanglement and geometry
connections.physics: In AdS/CFT, holographic entanglement entropy is related to the area of a minimal bulk surface anchored to a boundary region. In the static case, S_A = Area(γ_A)/(4G_N) in conventional units with appropriate ħ/c factors restored as needed.
connections.project_use: A particularly important research neighbor for the relationship-first framework: patterns of quantum entanglement can be tied to emergent bulk geometry in holographic settings. This is not evidence that social or spiritual relationships literally generate spacetime.

connections.name: Emergent geometry from entanglement
connections.physics: Modern holography studies how field-theory entanglement structure can diagnose or reconstruct aspects of bulk geometry.
connections.project_use: This is perhaps the strongest physics-side analogue yet for the Potatoverse claim that relationship can be more fundamental than isolated objects: in a specific quantum-gravity setting, relational quantum information is deeply connected with geometric structure.

connections.name: Branes — dimensional objects, not only point particles
connections.physics: M/string theory contains extended objects: strings, membranes and higher-dimensional p-branes. Eleven-dimensional M-theory prominently contains M2- and M5-branes, and many lower-dimensional string-theory branes arise through reduction/duality.
connections.project_use: A better dimensional grammar for the old point/line/frame/plane intuition: dimensions can describe the worldvolume of extended objects, but this should not be equated with the symbolic 1D Hell / 5D Door ladder.

connections.name: Singularity can signal an incomplete effective description
connections.physics: In Strominger's conifold example, the apparent singularity of the low-energy effective theory is cured when light states that had been integrated out are restored.
connections.project_use: This suggests a new Timic research question: when the archive encounters a contradiction or singular conceptual point, is the framework inconsistent, or is a relevant state/node/degree of freedom missing from the description? This is a methodological analogy, not a physical identification.

connections.name: Effective theory — truth can depend on scale without becoming arbitrary
connections.physics: Physics routinely uses effective descriptions valid only within specified energy/length regimes. Degrees of freedom that are negligible at one scale may become essential at another.
connections.project_use: This can formalize the archive's stage-specific canon: Potato, Sage, Father, country, institution and world-level descriptions can each be scale-appropriate without claiming that one vocabulary literally replaces all others.

new_timic_hypotheses_to_test: Timic Inversion may be better modeled as dual-description structure in some cases and actual phase transition in others; these must be distinguished.
Spiral/Return may be compared to holonomy: a closed path can return spatially while transforming an internal state.
Mirror/Twin should be tested against mirror-symmetry logic: same/equivalent structure can arise through exchanged geometric variables without literal identity.
Door may sometimes be a special locus in moduli space rather than a new spatial dimension.
Relationship-first may gain a rigorous physics analogue through holographic entanglement/geometry, but only within specific quantum-gravity models.
Conceptual singularities in the Potatoverse should trigger a missing-variable search before being treated as contradictions.
The archive should use effective-theory labels so claims are indexed by the scale/domain at which they are intended to operate.
